items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Bennie Moten (PHONETIC) used to break it up with the Moten swing.

ctx.x: Bennie Moten (PHONETIC). I think there was Bennie Moten (PHONETIC). Zack White, Chick Webb (PHONETIC), and the fifth band -- I'm trying to -- maybe it was Johnson's on that tour.
But there was supposed to have been seven bands on that tour I think. I'm trying to think of what that other band was.
